name: smwgraphics-metroid-fusion-pipeline-interior
title: Metroid Fusion - Pipeline Interior
description:
Here's the FG from the pipeline interior sections of Metroid Fusion. While the 'black' color must be used as BG color, you can also use the map16tile 4E0 to add the black color tile and have the back area color be used, for example, as a red alert, with some ASM.
Tileset uses level mode 2 as both FG and BG have the same scrolling.

Enjoy!
